component.name: LiveFaceSwap
component.summary: Real-time AI face swap from your webcam

description.p: LiveFaceSwap is a real-time AI face swap desktop client. It connects to the LiveFaceSwap cloud service, so no local GPU is required.
The Linux version provides real-time preview and does not currently include a virtual camera.
Live sessions consume metered credits at the rate shown before starting. Additional credits are available for purchase.
